components.title: NETApps Electric Simulation application, installer and privileged helper

changelog.text: Renamed NETApps Electric Simulation, with its own logo. New parts: transformer, three-phase transformer (Dyn, Yyn, Yd, Dd), three-phase source, relay, DC motor, single- and three-phase AC motors, hobby servo. Parameter sweep (.step), FFT view with THD, bill of materials, text notes, single-frequency AC analysis, property limits.

Potentiometer sliders follow the drag and keep the value; Ctrl+R and Shift+R rotate, Y flips; pan and zoom-area tools, a view toolbar on the canvas, Shift+wheel pans; every part checked in a test circuit; op-amp output limits and the LM358 low-side swing corrected; parts left on their own no longer stop the simulation; clearer messages for an unconnected ground and a reference already in use.

Wire and part collisions are asked about (connect, route around, cancel) instead of connected silently; window layout options: results below or beside the schematic, splitter, maximise, panels on and off, kept between sessions.

Increment 2 (D17): start screen and tutorial, schematic editor, electrical rule check, circuit simulator (operating point, transient, AC, DC sweep; cross-checked against ngspice), probes and waveform viewer, 555 timer and regulators, projects with version history, SVG/PNG/SPICE/CSV export.
Increment 1: application shell, CM backbone, integrity check, installer, privileged-helper skeleton.
